newsitem.title: USA: Waban to redeem 6.5 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Waban to redeem 6.5 pct debentures.

text.p: Waban Inc said Friday it has called for redemption on July 7 all of its 6.5 percent convertible subordinated debentures due July 1, 2002.

The company said debentures outstanding total $106,934,000 aggregate principal amount. The redemption price is $1,028.89 plus accrued interest of $1.0833 from July 1 to the redemption date for a total price of $1,029.97 for each $1,000 debenture.
No interest will accrue after the redemption date, it said.
Until 1800 EDT/2200 GMT June 26, the company said the convertible debentures are convertible into shares of Waban common stock at $24.75 per share, a rate of 40.404 shares for each $1,000 debenture.
Waban said it has a standby agreement with Prudential Securities Inc to have Prudential purchase up to 2,160,606 shares of Waban should no more than $53,474,000 of the debentures be redeemed.
The company also said it expects the previously announced spinoff of its BJ's Wholesale Club unit will be completed by the end of July.
The company said shareholders will be asked to approve the BJ's proposal at its annual meeting July 10 in Boston.
